description: List the signed-in account’s scored news Stories, filtered by minimum relevance and industry and sorted by relevance or recency. Returns a readable summary per Story (ID, title, source, URL, relevance as a percentage, summary) and structuredContent { count, stories } where each Story has id, title, summary, source_name, url, relevance_score (0 to 1), detected_at, urgency, status and metadata. Use it to find what is worth writing about today, then pass a Story id to get_story for the full record or to generate_post to write a Jack from it. Only Stories NewsJack has already scanned into this account are returned; it does not fetch feeds or search the web. Read-only, no allowance used. Needs the read:stories scope; anonymous callers get an authentication error. An empty result means nothing matched, so lower min_relevance or drop category.

category.description: Optional industry filter: the exact industry slug the Story was scanned for, one of music, tech, marketing, live-touring, sync-licensing, radio-podcast. Example: 'live-touring'. Any other value matches nothing. Omit to include every industry the account follows.

limit.description: Maximum number of Stories to return. Integer from 1 to 50, default 10. Example: 20.

min_relevance.description: Lowest relevance_score to include, from 0 to 1 (default 0.4). The text output shows the same score as a percentage, so 0.7 means 70%. Use 0 to see everything.

sort_by.description: Sort order: 'relevance' (highest relevance_score first, the default) or 'recency' (newest detected_at first).

name: list_stories
